item.title: Taxi Driver Arrested For Attempted Rape Of Delhi Tourist In Uttarakhand
item.description: A taxi driver in Uttarakhand’s Nainital was arrested for allegedly attempting to rape a 31-year-old tourist from Delhi, who spent the night in a forest before being rescued by police.

item.title: Himachal Pradesh Expands ‘Destitute’ Definition To Include Women Abandoned By Husbands
item.description: Himachal Pradesh has expanded the definition of “destitute women” to include women abandoned by their husbands without income, making them eligible for social security pension benefits under revised state rules.

item.title: Ramadan 2026: Iftar and Sehri Timings for March 8 Across India
